lockedAlert.title: Booking engine is not enabled
lockedAlert.description: Booking is switched off for your organization, so no asks, reminders or confirmations are sent. Contact your ShowFlow administrator to enable it.

offAlert.title: Booking flow is off
offAlert.description: No new asks go out, and no reminders, daily sends or confirmations are sent. Asks already sent still run until their answer-by time. Pick a flow above to turn it on.

templatesError.title: Booking templates could not be loaded

fromAddress.label: From address (Resend)
fromAddress.helper: Overrides the default sender address for all outgoing emails.

describe.paused: Booking flow paused. No new asks, reminders, daily sends or confirmations are sent.
describe.directBooking: {{Artists}} are booked directly; nobody has to answer first.
describe.tierAuto: The first ask goes out automatically
describe.deliveryDigest: asks go out in the {{hour}} daily send

dateCreated.title: {{ShowDate}} created
dateCreated.desc: Via Airtable sync or in-app; either way the {{showDate}} enters the flow here.

openOfferTier.title: Send the first ask
openOfferTier.desc: Asks everyone who can be asked in that group.
openOfferTier.autoOpenLabel: Ask the first group automatically when a new {{showDate}} is ready
openOfferTier.autoEscalateLabel: Move to the next group automatically when the answer-by time closes short
openOfferTier.atRiskLabel: Alert the {{roleProducer}} when the group being asked cannot fill the remaining parts
openOfferTier.atRiskHelper: Checked hourly. An alert is sent when booked {{artists}} plus live pending asks are fewer than the parts needed.

notifyArtists.title: Notify {{artists}}
notifyArtists.desc: How and when asks reach {{artists}}. The answer-by clock starts at delivery.
notifyArtists.expiryReminderLabel: Remind {{artists}} 24 h before they need to answer

artistAcceptance.title: {{Artist}} acceptance
artistAcceptance.desc: {{Artists}} say yes or no from their calendar. Off means {{roleProducer}} books directly, with no asks at all.
artistAcceptance.offNotice: Asks, daily sends, and answer-by times are skipped. {{roleProducer}} books from the who-can-be-asked list; the first touchpoint for the {{artist}} is the confirmation.

producerConfirmation.title: The last word
producerConfirmation.desc: You review {{artists}} who said yes and confirm the {{cast}}. Off means a yes books it immediately.
producerConfirmation.offNotice: With {{artist}} acceptance off, booking the {{artist}} is itself the confirmation, so this step can't be skipped.

confirmationDigest.title: Confirmation send
confirmationDigest.desc: Daily summary email to newly booked {{artists}}.

understudyPromotion.title: {{Understudy}} promotion
understudyPromotion.desc: When a main {{cast}} booking cancels, the longest-waiting {{understudy}} who said yes is promoted automatically.
